comment: WeftID defines no authentication context classes and emits no acr claim; the suite warns when acr_values was requested (SHOULD)
The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported=false); claims are released by scope only, so name is absent without the profile scope (SHOULD)
WeftID has no attributes for nickname, picture, website, gender, birthdate, middle_name, preferred_username, or profile; absent claims are omitted, never null (OIDC Core 5.1)
